How to teach it:

  

UI; is not one of the three paths. UI is the control plane — think of it like your brain's operating system. It doesn't 'live' a path like HP, LE, or GE. It runs them. Inside UI you'll find your AI agents, your standard operating procedures, your infrastructure, your security protocols, your development projects, and your research. If HP/LE/GE are the what of your life, UI is the how."
